name: ASIAPLY
recent: ASIAPLY 于 2026 年 8 月 21 日召开特别股东大会，股东通过了与经常性关联交易相关的新股东授权。同日，公司发布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度的合并业绩，并宣布签署一份谅解备忘录。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会上通过新股东授权，涉及与经常性关联方进行的收益或交易性质的关联交易。
公司签署一份谅解备忘录。
公司发布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度的合并业绩。

ann.title: Quarterly rpt on consolidated results for the financial period ended 30/06/2026

recent_en: ASIAPLY held an EGM on 21 August 2026 where shareholders approved a new shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions. On the same day, the company released its consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 and announced the signing of a memorandum of understanding.
notable_en: Shareholders passed a new shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions of a revenue or trading nature at the EGM.
The company signed a memorandum of understanding.
The company released its consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 June 2026.
